lines: Any form of dissent against the People's Government should be reported to the authorities.
We as a people must stand strong, and that can only be done by standing united!
A moldy column must be removed and replaced before it brings our house to the ground.
A dissident must be reeducated for the sake of the peace and tranquility of our nation.
It is our duty to root out all corruption from our beloved nation, as we are her children.
